title: output.verifiable_receipts input
description: Request envelope for attesting an output artifact (catalog shape `Receipt`; mirrors the `output_attest` tool arguments — exactly one content source is required). Advertise-only per RCX Session-Handshake v1; the field set is open (additive).

content_bytes_base64.description: The output content to attest, base64-encoded. Mutually exclusive with `content_path`.

content_path.description: Absolute path of a local file whose bytes are attested. Mutually exclusive with `content_bytes_base64`; a local-debug ergonomic, not a production input path.
